questions.question: What did Jeremiah wear as a sign in chapter 27?
options: Sackcloth and ashes on his head
A linen belt around his waist
A crown of thorns upon his brow
Yoke-bars and straps on his neck
questions.answer: Yoke-bars and straps on his neck

questions.question: What was God's message to the nations through this sign?
options: Submit and serve the king of Babylon and live
Rise up and throw off the Babylonian yoke
Make an alliance with all the surrounding kings
Flee to Egypt before the army arrives
questions.answer: Submit and serve the king of Babylon and live

questions.question: Jeremiah warned the people not to listen to prophets who said they would not serve Babylon.
Bring your necks under the _____ of the king of Babylon, and serve him and his people, and live.
The prophets who say you will not serve the king of Babylon are prophesying a _____ to you.
